text: Neha - back from Lisbon Sat. veggie now, no fish either. ask re pics

Moira = coeliac. proper coeliac not fad. note for xmas dinner
pick up dry cleaning / renew passport (exp 03/01!!) / buy adaptor plugs
Yetunde + hubby Tariq - Lagos for her dad's 70th, 2nd of Dec. back the week after
Samir hates coriander. like actually hates it. tastes of soap he says

Hiroshi @ lunch: knee op 21/11. off work 6 wks afterwards. wife Ming doing all the driving, not thrilled. he's worried abt the long flight to Osaka in Feb, physio said maybe ok by then if he does the exercises. aisle seat obvs. check in the day after op, and maybe drop off the Japanese snacks he likes (senbei, not the sweet ones) when he's home
Isabel - Greece trip cancelled, mum not well. she's gutted
Erin's bday 9 Jan. obsessed w/ matcha atm - matcha kit? whisk set?
Emily & Isaac - honeymoon Bali, leave 18th of Oct, 3 wks. ask about it when they're back
Joy - nut allergy (severe, carries epipen). her son too
Efua flew to Accra Tues for grandma's funeral. funeral that Fri. must message her that morning
Reggie aka Reg - started @ BA cabin crew. 1st long haul next wk, Singapore. bit nervous
Natasha - dry Jan + now dry Feb too lol. drinks: elderflower / ginger beer

me: flight LHR-JFK 6 Dec 0940, back 13th. check in online the day before. pack chargers, neck pillow, melatonin. book airport parking this wk - cheaper early. ask for veggie meal on the outbound (didn't last time & regretted it). hotel in Brooklyn, 2 nights, then train up to Boston the next morning. sort ESTA!!
Siobhan - dog Biscuit had op on paw Mon. recovering ok. Siobhan stressed abt vet bills

Manon's sister Alessia getting married in Lyon 12 June. Manon maid of honour, speech terrifying her. hen do in Porto the month before, 3 nights, she's sorting the whole thing + one of the bridesmaids is pescatarian, one's keto, so dinner booking a nightmare. offer to help w/ speech? she said she'd send me a draft
Khadija - fasting Mon/Thu. dont book lunches those days
Zeynep back from Istanbul. brought me lokum. says baklava from Karaköy best ever. thank her
Ilse vegan 2 yrs. loves oat flat white. hates mushrooms tho
Grace - interview @ Heathrow ops 4/11. prep'd loads. text gl the day before + ask how it went afterwards
Damian: moved to Dubai w/ work. Back 23rd Dec for 2 wks
Phoebe & Matteo - Japan Apr. Phoebe's first long flight, scared of turbulence
groceries / gin for sat / oat milk / bin bags. book car MOT before 30/10
Ximena - pregnant!! due 7 May. off sushi + soft cheese obvs. so happy for her

Jorge's mum Carmen in hosp since Thurs. hip, fell in the kitchen. he's flying to Madrid the day after tmrw, open return. his sister Ximena already out there. he's in bits tbh, worried about leaving his dog Pepe w/ neighbours. ring him when he lands + offer to walk Pepe
Ming hates long flights - always does stopover in Dubai. fave airline Emirates
Alice - leaving do Fri 7th Nov, @ the Crown. retiring after 30 yrs! card + flowers
Tariq off dairy, doc's orders. lactose intolerant apparently
Carmen's brother Jorge back from Australia 1st of Dec after a yr. family party that wknd
Neha + Samir - anniversary trip to Paris. 5 yrs. they go 15/02, back the 18th
Catalina likes: dark choc, pisco sours, anything spicy. no olives
Moira's husband Reggie - surgery 2 Dec, heart. she's v anxious. pop round the day before w/ food (GF!)
own plan: cancel gym, start running club 1st Nov. new trainers first
Yetunde said Lagos trip off - flights too ££. doing Xmas here instead
Hiroshi - Kyoto 3 wks in spring, visiting parents. dad 80 in March
Isabel's mum (Mrs Garcia) home from hosp. Isabel shattered. send her something nice
Erin & her gf Joy - moving to Bristol, end of Nov. leaving drinks 22/11
Emily said Bali amazing, Isaac got food poisoning day 2 lol. all fine now
Isaac - wants a decent espresso machine. hints dropped
Efua back home. funeral was hard. her aunt staying w/ her til Sun
Reggie survived Singapore! jetlag brutal. next one LA 20th
chemist - malaria tablets. start them 2 days before flight. GP for jabs

Natasha - mum's 60th 30 Nov, surprise dinner @ the Italian place. Natasha organising, stressing about the cake - mum's diabetic so needs low sugar, and half the family are vegetarian. she wants me to collect the cake that morning from the bakery on Hill St. then drinks after at hers. remember to bring prosecco + something AF
Siobhan's boss signed off her hols - Iceland 8-12 Jan. northern lights!! ask her for pics after
Khadija - Hajj next yr w/ her parents. huge for her
Zeynep's daughter Efua - first day @ nursery 3rd of Nov. Zeynep more nervous than Efua

Ilse + Grace - long w/e in Copenhagen 28/11. Ilse found a vegan tasting menu, Grace v sceptical, she's a steak person. 3rd anniversary that wknd too so it's a big deal for Ilse. flying from Stansted at 6am, Grace not a morning person. ask how the dinner went the week after, curious if Grace converted
Damian - can't eat gluten, not coeliac, just bloated. beer = no. wine fine
Phoebe - gave her the travel pillow. she loved it
Ximena - baby shower 15 Mar, I'm doing the food. mostly veggie
Jorge back from Madrid. Carmen recovering slowly. he's knackered, flies back again 2 wks later. call him wknd
Ming - tea snob. oolong only. brings her own bags to work
Alice's grandson Isaac - school trip to Paris, first time abroad, 11 Mar. she's more worried than him
Matteo - nonna turning 90, party in Turin 4th of Jan. whole family flying in the day before

Tariq's wife Khadija - new job @ Emirates, starts 10/11. they're moving to Dubai the month after. selling the flat first, viewings every sat. Tariq not sure abt the heat, or no pork scratchings lol. leaving party @ theirs 1st Nov, bring something non-alc for Khadija. must sort a leaving gift - she wants a decent sunhat apparently
Alessia loves negronis. Campari = the gift. don't forget her bday is 2 Feb
Catalina back from Bogotá - flight went fine, kid slept 8hrs!! told me about the arepa place near her mum's

Moira's Reggie - op went ok. home Fri, rehab the wk after. Moira finally sleeping. drop round soup sat, GF bread, & check how she's doing. her sister Siobhan's coming up from Leeds the Mon after to help so she'll get a break then. ask Moira if she needs anything from shops

Samir @ dinner - doing Ramadan properly this yr, first time since uni. iftar at his place 1st wk, he's inviting me + Neha + Hiroshi. bring dates? he said Medjool, not the dry ones. also mentioned his brother Damian is getting married in Karachi in spring, whole family flying out, he's dreading the 14hr journey w/ his nan
